Every piece is handmade to order. Orders placed through October 31 (Halloween rush): 10–15 business days to make. Orders placed after October 31: 5–7 business days to make. Returns are accepted within 30 days. The buyer pays return shipping, and a refund is issued once the item is received and inspected. See the full shipping & returns policy.
